Two asks to start the plan:
- Proposed 10-day cutover window (canary + progressive traffic ramp) — need your recommended staging cadence.
- Safety nets: what automatic fallbacks do you recommend if p95 latency exceeds 450ms or error rate increases during ramp?

Thanks,
Sarah

Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated switchover window and fallback asks

Hi Sarah — appreciate the profile. Early thoughts below, copying Monica to sync on acceptance gates and Ben for sizing detail.

Proposed high-level cadence (10-day window broken down):
1) Day 0–2: Provision reserved pool (staging) + baseline smoke (light traffic mirror).
2) Day 3–5: Canary (1% -> 10% traffic ramp) with KV-cache warmup and prefix caching enabled.
3) Day 6–8: Progressive ramp to 50–75% with throttled burst allowance and autoscaler watch.
4) Day 9–10: Full cutover with rollback window and retained fallback to hosted pool.

Safety net options we recommend:
- Automatic region fallback to secondary us-west cluster if latency breach detected for > 3 consecutive 5-min checks.
- Auto-rollback to hosted variant if error rate > 1.5% sustained over 10 minutes during ramp.
- Temporary scale-up (burst capacity) with pre-authorized throttled credits for the canary week.

Open items: expected sustained tokens/sec during canary week, and whether you want a scheduled maintenance blackout for third-party integrations.

I will have Ben follow up with a concrete GPU sizing proposal (type, per-replica batch sizing, expected steady-state rep count).

—Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated switchover window and fallback asks — initial sizing

On Thu, Sep 30, 2026 at 11:03 AM Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> (above)

Quick sizing notes based on the provided profile and the target 1800 RPS burst pattern:
- Recommended fleet: 16 x A100-80GB (or 20 x A100-40GB equivalent) as a starting reserved pool.
- Replica config: 1 GPU per replica, continuous batching target 64 tokens/batch, 8 concurrent contexts per replica.
- Expected steady-state token throughput per GPU: ~220K tokens/min with quantization profile q4_0.
- Canary week: provision 20% extra headroom (add 3 GPUs) and enable prefix/KV cache for warmups.

Operational guardrails:
- Heatmaps + p95 alert thresholds preconfigured in Console; p95 > 450ms triggers automatic patient slowdown (cap request rate per route) and notifies on-call.
- If errors spike > 1.5% during ramp, auto-fallback to hosted with a DNS-weighted drain (60s) to avoid thundering.

Attaching a PDF with the math and throughput curves. Please confirm whether you want us to reserve the entire fleet for the first 30 days or do a stepped commit.

[Attachment: gpu-sizing-v1.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]

—Ben
Ben Carter
Capacity PM, Redwood Inference
